system.description:
Brings ill fortune and harm on enemies: curses, pain, bewitchment and ruin. The most feared and often the most corrupt Art.

Sword Chronicle p. 100. A Sorcerous Benefit (Blood of the Sorcerers, Blood of the Far Isles, Natural Sorcerer or Sorcerous Initiation) grants access.
system.tools: Poppets and symbolic representations of the target, hair, nail parings, blood and other bodily links.
system.initiation: Use Will instead of Status for your Intrigue Defense and intrigue initiative.
system.resonances: A link to the target for Rituals.
